'''Leyakians''' were a [[Human/Legends|humanoid]] race. One notable member of this [[Species/Legends|species]] was [[By Bluss/Legends|By Bluss]], a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
